title: Working Scientifically
seo_title: Year 2 Science: Working Scientifically Worksheets (Questions, Tests and Tally Charts)
standard_text: Ask simple questions and recognise that they can be answered in different ways; observe closely, using simple equipment; perform simple tests; identify and classify; use their observations and ideas to suggest answers to questions; gather and record data to help in answering questions.
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on working scientifically: asking questions, observing with simple equipment, fair tests, sorting into groups and tally charts. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Change one thing in a test and write down what you find.
body_html:
How to think about it

Scientists ask, look, test and record.

  • Ask a question you can test.
  • Observe closely and measure with the right equipment.
  • Sort things into groups and record results in tables and tally charts.
Example

Look at a beetle closely with?

Makes things look bigger

Answer: a magnifying glass

Example

Dog, cat, rabbit, rock: odd one out?

Not living

Answer: the rock

Common mistakes

  • Changing two things at once in a test.
  • Guessing instead of looking carefully.
  • Forgetting to write the results down.

faq.a: Each line is one. Four lines with a line across them make a group of five. Count the fives, then the single lines.
